prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-03 for page 34-X-12-auth-verify-email, state default. Reference state: email verification sent page. Create a minimal support-oriented variant where the user can resend, switch email, login, reset password, or go home.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS title bar, device frame, or watermark. No sidebar. Center a clean Snow auth card on Mist background. Include top mail icon, title, compact explanation, email input, full-width Obsidian resend button, small frequency warning, '메일이 안 왔나요?' help block, other email signup button, login and password reset secondary buttons, footer links.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design-friendly auth help page, compact density, neutral, no marketing hero.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian #09090b only for resend CTA; neutral secondary actions; no gradients.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, button labels fit.
Must preserve state signals: verification email sent, email target field, resend CTA, frequency note, not received help, other email signup, login/password reset/home links.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, decorative illustration, colorful CTA, heavy shadow, oversized card radius.
